answer: Require every payout to pass through a karst filter: funds seep slowly down through a porous ledger of small, individually attested grants rather than arriving in one lump, so a fleet must justify each droplet separately and cannot concentrate power. Identity is carved in jade, a hard stone that cracks visibly under tampering, so any attempt to reuse one identity across roles leaves a permanent fracture peers can inspect. Reputation grows in juniper rings, one ring per epoch of continuous honest presence, and a broken ring is visible forever.
